text:
Aisha: Heads-up: exec requested a compact "MVP traffic plan" for the Redwood public launch — they want clarity on which features are mandatory for launch and which can move to v1. Can we get a quick convening?
Liam: I'm in. main constraint is cost runway and customer pilots that need private deployments.
Diego: From infra: we can ship hosted API + minimal console without dedicated pools. But latency under peak could spike; need fallback policy.
Noor: Product note: customers care most about predictable latency, SSO, and pilot isolation. Everything else is secondary.
Aisha: Proposed short matrix in thread. Keep it terse please.
Liam: quick matrix draft:
```
Feature                         | Decision (MVP/v1) | Owner   | Quick rationale
------------------------------- | ----------------- | ------- | ---------------------------
Hosted API                      | MVP               | Eng API | Core surface, low lift
Basic Console (login, key mgmt) | MVP               | Product | Needed for onboarding
Console analytics               | v1                | Product | Nice-to-have for launch
Dedicated pools                 | v1                | Eng infra | Heavy infra cost
Private deploy (VPC)           | v1                | Sales   | Enterprise sales blocker
Optimize (batching hints)       | v1                | ML infra| Cost tooling, iterates
SSO / Enterprise auth           | MVP (partial)     | Sec     | Basic SSO ok; advanced to v1
Telemetry retention             | MVP (30 days)     | Eng SRE | Lowers infra footprint
Canary/rollback primitives      | MVP               | Eng SRE | Safety requirement
```
Diego: For the fallback: propose an automated policy: if p95 latency > 250ms for 30m, switch routing to a quantized model variant (adds ~20ms but halves GPU pressure). Ops estimate: 2.5 engineer-weeks.
Noor: Sales ops: I'll compile pilot accounts that would be blocked and categorize them as hard/soft blockers.
Aisha: Final ask: can everyone drop a 1-line acceptance criteria for their rows by EOD? I want this in the exec packet.
Liam: API acceptance: 5k rps sustained for 1 hour with p95 < 200ms on canary traffic.
Diego: infra acceptance: fallback policy implemented + tested in staging; monitoring alerts for latency and fallback events.
Noor: product acceptance: console login + key creation + one partner onboarding flow validated end-to-end.
Aisha: perfect. ops-bot: auto note: milestone "public-launch-mvp" updated, linked PRs: #4123 #4128
Aisha: I'll stitch the matrix into the packet and share. thanks all.
